chunks: You worship idols in place of God and invent lies. Surely those you worship other than God have no power over your means of livelihood. So seek your sustenance from God, and worship Him and give Him thanks. To Him will you be brought back in the end.
ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between idol worship and the concept of sustenance (rizq) in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ontological insufficiency of idols, which are merely created entities lacking the divine attribute of *Rizq* (sustenance), thereby invalidating their worship. It serves as a practical directive for believers to direct their spiritual and material reliance (*tawakkul*) exclusively to Allah, reinforcing the concept of *Tawhid* in both essence and action. The reminder of ultimate return (*ma'ad*) highlights the accountability of this exclusive devotion.
